title: A gradient can be saved in the Library under a name
goal: A color you like can be kept in the Library under a name and reused, but only when it is one flat color. A gradient you spent time getting right cannot be kept at all, so the next shape that wants it has to be built again by hand. Let a gradient be saved and reused the same way a color is.
notes: Follow-up from a-color-slot-can-hold-a-gradient-not-just-a-flat. ColorStyle holds colorHex: String today (PhotonzCore/ColorStyles.swift); widening it to Paint is the same trick Paint itself used: keep the wire key, encode a bare string while solid. The Library tile and every swatch that draws a style will want PaintFill rather than Color(hex:).
acceptance: Save style inside the picker keeps a gradient, not just its flat color
A saved gradient appears on the Library shelf drawn as the gradient it is
Applying a saved gradient to another shape paints the whole ramp and its aim
Editing a saved gradient repaints everything wearing it, in one step
